analysis.title: GS Consumer: WMT Tactical Take & Peer Read
key_insights: Walmart (WMT) was up 1-2% in the first minutes after the print, then indicated -1% in pre-market. Investor feedback is very modestly cautious.
The print is not a thesis changer in either direction, with a modest down arrow. GS expects a smaller move than the last two quarters (-9% on T+0 last quarter, -7% the quarter before).
The print was very modestly light of investor expectations. The most likely scenario, depending on the tape, is small downside on the day.

WMT has traded lower on EPS day in 6 of the last 7 quarters but has recovered each time. It is within 6% of its all-time high and still trades at a 40x multiple. XLP closing near all-time highs is cited as supportive.
Expectations were for a modest beat. The beat was smaller than expected. The key metrics were Walmart US comp and gross margin.
Walmart US comp was 10 bps above consensus but about 10-30 bps below investor expectations.
Gross margin was a clean beat, but SG&A limited flow-through. Some investors pushed back on beating EPS by only $0.01.

GS does not expect a significant peer read-through. TGT's print the previous day (+5.6% comp, +5% traffic) looks slightly better relative to WMT. Dollar stores, select off-price retailers and BJ, which have yet to report, are not expected to change much.

market_movers.rationale: Small beat on EPS and revenue but slightly below investor expectations on Walmart US comp and with a 4Q EPS guide below consensus. The stock is indicated -1% pre-market, and GS sees small downside on the day as most likely.
TGT's print the previous day (+5.6% comp, +5% traffic) looks a bit better in comparison with WMT's modestly light print.

sector_views.rationale: The note says XLP closing near all-time highs helps WMT's stock hold up, and does not give a sector rating.

earnings_insights: WMT 3Q reported EPS $0.65 vs consensus $0.64 (reported 11/19). Revenue $187.6B vs consensus $187.4B.
WMT Walmart US comps +2.9% reported vs consensus +2.8% and investor expectations of +3-3.2%. Sam's Club comps +4.9% reported vs consensus +4.8%.
WMT gross margin beat by 30 bps and SG&A missed by 30 bps vs expectations.
WMT implied 4Q EPS guide is $0.72-$0.77 vs consensus $0.78.
WMT category comps: grocery +MSD, Health & Wellness -LSD, General merchandise +LSD, with toys and auto care strong.
risk_factors: SG&A deleverage limited gross margin flow-through to EPS.
4Q EPS guide of $0.72-$0.77 is below the $0.78 consensus.
WMT's 40x multiple leaves the stock exposed to a light print.
vol_and_positioning: WMT has traded lower on EPS day in 6 of the last 7 quarters.
WMT fell 9% on T+0 last quarter and 7% the quarter before.

tension_points.bull_case: The stock was up 1-2% initially after the print. Gross margin was a clean 30 bps beat, and the stock has always recovered after falling on EPS day. It is within 6% of its all-time high, with XLP near highs.
tension_points.bear_case: Walmart US comp was 10-30 bps light of investor expectations, SG&A missed by 30 bps, the 4Q EPS guide is below consensus, and the stock still trades at 40x. The stock has fallen on EPS day in 6 of the last 7 quarters.
